channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Bradley Beal | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Bradley Beal from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Bradley Beal, Derrick Jones
item.description:
Tyronn Lue:

“When we first came into the season, we thought we had a great team, we thought we had a great chance. And so when you lose Bradley Beal, when you lose Kawhi, you lose Derrick Jones, you lose Bogie, things can get hard. And so they have been hard for us”

Tyronn Lue on Bradley Beal, Derrick Jones, Dec 9, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Bogdan Bogdanovic on Chris Paul, Bradley Beal
item.description:
Bogdan Bogdanovic:

“It's an honor to play with guys like Bradley Beal, Chris Paul. You can see the experience. They can help us out definitely. I have to say also, the young guys have been training hard. They've been pushing everybody else. We have to give them credit as well.”

Bogdan Bogdanovic on Chris Paul, Bradley Beal, Oct 1, 2025. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Chris Paul on Bradley Beal
item.description:
Chris Paul on being teammates with Bradley Beal:

“I'm excited because a lot of times you know guys, but you don't really know them until you're teammates. I'm excited to be teammates with Brad this year.”

Chris Paul on Bradley Beal, Sep 29, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Devin Booker on Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal
item.description:
Devin Booker on two-year run with Kevin Durant and Bradley Beal:

“It was tough. I think just not getting to where we wanted to with Kevin and Brad, two guys that I have a high respect for and always will. The opportunity to play alongside with them was a lot in its own, but it will always be a disappointment to me to not do what we all sought out to do.”

Devin Booker on Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal, Sep 25, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Brian Gregory on Bradley Beal
item.description:
Brian Gregory on his view of Bradley Beal and the Suns possibly parting ways:

“Well, my view of Brad will never change. And I appreciate that question, but again, with negotiations and contract stuff, we just don’t talk about the players.”

Brian Gregory on Bradley Beal, Jul 8, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal
item.description:
Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal's calf:

“He left a lot out there on the court, came in yesterday, had a great day on the table, put a lot of time in... I don’t think it was one incident, it’s just a physical game, the wear and tear of the game, his calf kinda had some tightness”

Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal, Feb 27, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal
item.description:
Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal's toe sprain:

“I think that the break is gonna be good for us and good for Brad as far as his health and his toe. I don't want to say for certain, but I think there's a lot of hope that, coming out of the break, he's gonna be in a good place”

Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal, Feb 11, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal
item.description:
Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal (left great toe soreness):

“He did not practice today. I think it’s going to take him a little bit more time.”

Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal, Feb 10, 2025. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Bradley Beal
item.description:
Kevin Durant on Bradley Beal's sixth man role:

“I don't know the difference between his minutes coming off the bench or starting, but is it about the same? So like, is it really a change?... Ifeel like he's just comfortable and understanding where his shot's gonna come from”

Kevin Durant on Bradley Beal, Jan 10, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Mike Budenholzer on Brad Beal being back:

“I think he's excited to be backand we're excited to have him back.”

Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal, Dec 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Tyus Jones on Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal
item.description:
Tyus Jones on the emotional lift that having Kevin Durant and Bradley Beal back would provide:

“It's huge for us. K and Brad do a lot for us, they carry a lot of the weight for us. So that was a big loss. Not having one of them is a big loss, but not having both of them was huge”

Tyus Jones on Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal, Nov 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal
item.description:
Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal's progress from the left calf strain:

“Brad is putting in work to get back.... There's a lot of work that he put in today with our sports performance team, with our medical team. We feel like he's making good progress, but there's no update.”

Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal, Nov 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Josh Bartelstein on Bradley Beal
item.description:
Suns CEO Josh Bartelstein told ESPN.

“I mean, Bradley Beal has led the league in scoring. Let's get him back to that.”

Josh Bartelstein on Bradley Beal, Oct 31, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal's sore elbow:

“I think he got tangled up in a screen really late in the game,and yeah, it's just one of those things that happens when you're fighting through screens, and hopefully it's not significant”

Mike Budenholzer on Bradley Beal, Oct 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Reggie Miller on Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal, Devin Booker
item.description:
“Whenever you have Kevin Durant and Devin Booker, and then you add Bradley Beal, hopefully he can be healthy for 65, 70 games, you always have a puncher’s chance,”

Reggie Miller on Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal, Devin Booker, Oct 17, 2024. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Royce O'Neale on Bradley Beal
item.description:
Royce O'Neale on Bradley Beal's recent spark:

“All the sacrifices he made from the day I've been here til now, every day he's putting guys in the right situations to get better and being the leader on this team and playing defense.... Heknows what time it is and we got his back”

Royce O'Neale on Bradley Beal, Apr 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Drew Hanlen on Bradley Beal, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Drew Hanlen:

“I always gave him trouble because I’ve had Bradley Beal and Jayson Tatum both score 60 [points]. Joel’s previous career-high was 59. So I used to always give him trouble and say he’s scared of 60. He would say, ‘One of these days I’m going to go out there and go crazy.’ To score 70 points in any game? It doesn’t matter if it’s a rec game. That’s impressive. Also against somebody that’s going to finish first or second in Defensive Player of the Year (voting)? Wemby is looking like he has the chance to become one of the all-timers, if he keeps improving at the rate he’s improving. That makes it even more of a cool feat.”

Drew Hanlen on Bradley Beal, Jayson Tatum, Apr 16, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Bradley Beal
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Kevin Durant on Bradley Beal and the Big 3's balance:

“There's gonna be times where we all gonna have our chances to initiate and get guys going, and Brad's done a good job of making the extra pass, getting into the lane, finding guys. We actually want him to be more aggressive”

Kevin Durant on Bradley Beal, Apr 4, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: John Wall on Bradley Beal
item.description:
“This when I really say I f*ck with Bradley Beal, and we got closer... I called him like, 'Man, my mom died.' He comes down there, we kick it and talk. It's emotional as hell.”

John Wall on Bradley Beal, Mar 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Bradley Beal, Devin Booker
item.description:
Kevin Durant on Bradley Beal taking over PG duties & driving w/ Devin Booker out:

“He’s brought the ball up before, but I think he’s playing, like, traditional point guard right now, where he’s setting up the offense every single time down. He’s giving up shots for his teammates”

Kevin Durant on Bradley Beal, Devin Booker, Mar 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal, Devin Booker
item.description:
Billy Donovan on the Phoenix Suns with Durant, Beal and Booker available:

“The three of them on the floor together are head and shoulders the best offense in the league.”

Billy Donovan on Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal, Devin Booker, Jan 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @byjuliapoe.

item.title: Devin Booker on Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal
item.description:
“But it always feels better when we all get back together and get in the gym and start cleaning things up. Looking at the history of who we have around here. The likes of Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal and a championship coach in Coach Vogel, I trust everybody in here.”

Devin Booker on Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal, Dec 23, 2023. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Brian Scalabrine on Bradley Beal, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
The 16-year-old attended Jayson Tatum's Elite Camp a few weeks back and according to Brian Scalabrine, who has worked out with the top high school prospect and Maine native, Flagg was going at it with Suns star Bradley Beal.

“I heard a rumor that my boy Cooper Flagg was at Jayson Tatum’s camp and he was busting Brad Beal 1-on-1, and Brad Beal got mad at him. Started cussing him out,”

Brian Scalabrine on Bradley Beal, Jayson Tatum, Aug 2, 2023. Source: Sporting News.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Bradley Beal
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Frank Vogel:

“Bradley Beal is one of the best players in the NBA,and we're thrilled to have him as a Phoenix Sun.”

Frank Vogel on Bradley Beal, Jun 29, 2023. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Mat Ishbia on Bradley Beal, Jordan Goodwin, Isaiah Todd
item.description:
Suns Owner Mat Ishbia said.

“Bradley Beal is one of the best players in the NBA and brings so much to our team including incredible work ethic, great character, and the mindset of a champion. Jordan and Isaiah add talent and versatility to our roster that will continue to make this team among the league’s best. We are committed to bringing an NBA championship to Phoenix and I could not be more excited about how this organization is coming together heading into the upcoming season.”

Mat Ishbia on Bradley Beal, Jordan Goodwin, Isaiah Todd, Jun 24, 2023. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Mat Ishbia on Bradley Beal, Jordan Goodwin, Isaiah Todd
item.description:
“We are thrilled to welcome Bradley, Jordan and Isaiah to the Phoenix Suns as we continue to build one of the premier organizations in all of sports,”

Mat Ishbia on Bradley Beal, Jordan Goodwin, Isaiah Todd, Jun 24, 2023. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Bradley Beal
item.description:
a league source told Heavy Sports.

“It really wasn’t that; it was tax consequences with Beal that really caused them to back off. The new tax is much more onerous. “And I think part of it was that Beal said he wouldn’t give up the no-trade clause in his contract (after the initial deal was complete).”

Damian Lillard on Bradley Beal, Jun 20, 2023. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Bradley Beal
item.description:
“I was going to play no. 2 to Brad [Bradley Beal]... The narrative started to get spun, they were saying I wanted to run the team [Wizards].”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Bradley Beal, Mar 22, 2023. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Bradley Beal, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Kyle Kuzma on how playing with Bradley Beal and Kristaps Porzingis will affect his free agent decision:

“It plays into it a lot. I love playing with those guys. I see how easy it is for me, but this is something I’m not really thinking about right now. I’m so far away from it.”

Kyle Kuzma on Bradley Beal, Kristaps Porzingis, Jan 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: John Wall on LeBron James, Trevor Ariza, JR Smith, Kevin Love, Tristan Thompson, Bradley Beal, Markieff Morris
item.description:
“Me and Kyrie, we matchin’ up. I’m taking [Bradley Beal] over [JR Smith]. You got [LeBron James] over Trevor Ariza. Kevin Love and Markieff Morris, I’m taking Kevin Love but Markieff Morris can shoot threes and post up. I’m taking [Marcin] Gortat over Tristan Thompson,”

John Wall on LeBron James, Trevor Ariza, JR Smith, Kevin Love, Tristan Thompson, Bradley Beal, Markieff Morris, Jan 19, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.
